ms.promise: Build course material consisting of modules (see acceptance criteria) using Student Learning targets. It will follow a "Project based learning approach practiced at Gimbalabs. For examples of this see: https://app.andamio.io/course
ms.criteria:
Course will be available on the F13 github repository in html form. 
It will consist of the following modules:
・Step by step guide about how to setup a node.
・Overview of currently running services
・Ogmios
・Cardano Token Registry
・Cardano GraphQL
・Koios (koios-artifacts)
・Dandelion PostGREST
・Unimatrix
・Manifest
・Statistics
・Introduction into docker and maintenance tasks.
・Podman overview and maintanance.
・Guide about how to add new services.

Students will already need to have basic sysadmin tasks. Course will use Ubuntu server as OS.
